implementation: Daemon status declares creation_protocol_version=1 for expected-project UUID and read-only enforcement
Stdio MCP relay verifies actual live daemon capability before every business request
Cindy adapter rejects incompatible daemons before dispatch and reports package/service compatibility separately
No fallback strips the binding constraint; no automatic service stop or write replay
Runtime Manual explains preserving drafts and coordinating shared service replacement
